writeup: Woot has a new OtterBox Symmetry Series cactus-leather embroidery case for the Samsung Galaxy S26+ in Ink Blossom (Black), model 77-99965, for $12.99. This is the embroidered cactus-leather Symmetry, not a plain plastic shell. OtterBox currently has that exact Ink Blossom embroidery case in stock at $48.99, and the Costco OtterBox shop lists it at $49.99. That is 73 percent and about $36 below OtterBox's current price. Quantity is 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
